title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: From silent library floors to active student center lounges, these ten spots offer the best environments for focused academic work at Brooklyn College.

cards.entity_name: Brooklyn College Library Silent Study Spaces
cards.title: Library Silent Study Floors
cards.subtitle: Brooklyn College Library
cards.notes: Head to designated silent zones for absolute quiet. These areas strictly prohibit conversation and phone use to ensure a distraction-free environment for deep focus.
cards.short_summary: Designated silent zones within the main library for distraction-free individual work.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers designated silent study spaces for students seeking a quiet environment.
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; check the library website for daily schedules.

cards.title: Topfer Library Café
cards.subtitle: Whitehead Hall, First Floor
cards.notes: Utilize 80 workstations and lounge seating in this 24/7-capable space. It features printing, scanning, and a snack bar for long study sessions.
cards.short_summary: A high-tech study lounge in Whitehead Hall with 80 workstations and 24-hour access potential.
cards.evidence_claim: The Library Café is located on the first floor of Whitehead Hall and has 80 workstations and lounge seating.
cards.source_title: Library Café - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Hours vary by semester; typically open late during finals. Located in Whitehead Hall.

cards.title: Student Center 5th Floor Study Room
cards.subtitle: Student Center, 5th Floor
cards.notes: Visit the fifth floor for a dedicated quiet area away from the busier lower levels. It is an ideal alternative when the main library is at capacity.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated quiet study room located on the top floor of the Student Center.
cards.evidence_claim: If you desire quiet time to study, visit our Study Room on the fifth floor of the Student Center.

cards.title: Gerboth Music Library
cards.subtitle: Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Find a specialized environment for music research and quiet study. This second-floor unit offers a more niche, academic atmosphere than general floors.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library on the second floor of the main library building focused on music study.
cards.evidence_claim: The music library is located on the second floor of the Brooklyn College Library and offers facilities for music study and research.
cards.access_notes: Access is available during specific Music Library hours, which may differ from main library hours.

cards.title: Boylan Hall Learning Center
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, Room 1300
cards.notes: Access peer tutoring and writing support in a collaborative setting. It is best for students who need active help while they study.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative study and tutoring hub located in the historic Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Center is located in 1300 Boylan Hall and provides tutoring and writing support.
cards.source_title: Support Offices on Campus - BC Knowledge for Students
cards.access_notes: Check the Learning Center website for specific tutoring schedules and walk-in hours.

cards.title: Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Library, Various Floors
cards.notes: Request one of 17 rooms at the New Media Desk on the 2nd floor. These are available on a first-come, first-served basis for collaborative projects.
cards.short_summary: Seventeen reservable rooms for group work located throughout the main library.
cards.evidence_claim: There are 17 group study rooms available for use by Brooklyn College students on a first come, first served basis.
cards.source_title: Reserve a Room - Library Event Calendar
cards.access_notes: Must request in person at the New Media Desk, 2nd Floor Library.

cards.title: Student Center Computer Corner
cards.subtitle: Student Center, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Drop by for a quick session to finish papers. This lab typically has less traffic than other campus facilities while maintaining high bandwidth.
cards.short_summary: A convenient first-floor computer lab in the Student Center for quick academic tasks.
cards.evidence_claim: The Computer Corner on the first floor has less traffic than other labs on campus with the same bandwidth.

cards.title: Boylan Hall 5th Floor Nooks
cards.subtitle: Boylan Hall, 5th Floor
cards.notes: Trek to the top floor for secluded tables and a quiet atmosphere. These spots are often overlooked due to the walk, offering a peaceful retreat.
cards.short_summary: Quiet, secluded study tables located at the ends of the fifth-floor corridors in Boylan Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Hidden at each end of the 5th floor at Boylan Hall, lays vacant seats and a medium-size square table for two.
cards.source_title: The Best Place to Eat or Study Alone in Brooklyn College
cards.access_notes: Accessible via stairs or elevator in Boylan Hall during building operating hours.

cards.title: West Quad Center Lounges
cards.subtitle: West Quad Center
cards.notes: Find modern seating and open spaces in this central service hub. It is convenient for studying between administrative appointments or gym sessions.
cards.short_summary: Modern, open-plan study areas located within the West Quad Center building.
cards.evidence_claim: The West Quad Center is home to student services and recreational facilities, offering light-filled spaces.
cards.access_notes: Open during standard building hours; typically follows administrative office schedules.

cards.title: New Media Center
cards.subtitle: Library, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Access high-end creative software and hardware for academic projects. This space is tailored for students working on digital media and design assignments.
cards.short_summary: A technology-focused study and production space on the library's second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: The New Media Center on the 2nd floor provides specialized technology and study space.
cards.access_notes: Check the New Media Center desk for specific equipment loan and room access rules.
